gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; MRI Spectroscopy; Tumor Microenvironment; Biomarkers / Blood
Patients consecutively identified in the multidisciplinary consultation meeting of neurooncology with a new diagnosis of GBM / a probable diagnosis of GBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: The study will be conducted without any major modification of the standard management of GBM.
The investigators propose to address the link between the MRS profile of GBM and basic clinical and biological parameters

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The investigators plan to recruit 30 newly diagnosed GBM patients for which surgery / radiochemotherapy will be proposed in the Medical oncology unit of Amiens University Hospital.

coder_notes: Observational-style correlative MRS / blood metabolomics study registered as interventional, phase NA; interventions are an MRS device and blood sampling, no drug. Standard surgery/radiochemotherapy is not a registered intervention and no drug is named, so no agents listed. MRS metabolite ratios (imaging) and plasma metabolites (non-tumour, blood) not recorded as tumour molecular biomarkers. cns5 'historical' because the record uses 'glioblastoma multiforme'.
